notes.subject: ⟨ye … ye⟩
notes.rationale: Bamanankan equative ni sira; Heburukan ma copula sɔrɔ

notes.subject: מפץ / ונפצתי
notes.rationale: Daɲɛ minnw bɛ fɔlɔkɔrɔda, bɔli-daɲɛ min bɛ kɔ fɛ, a bɛ kokura ka kɛ masin ye; kelen-kelen bɛ to a yɛrɛ la, nka sɛbɛn in tɛ se ka jɛya a cogo la

notes.subject: min bɛ wele ɔ
notes.rationale: Yawe fɔ ko 'i' — masinw bɛ a la (Babilɔn, Sirus walima a ka kalanbaga); bɔcogo ma jira a yɛrɛ kunmin

notes.subject: Yawe bɛ fɔ masin dɔ ma
notes.rationale: Wale-flannen kuma min bɛ daminɛ ni 'i' ye (v. 20–23), a taamasiyɛn kɔrɔ tɛ a kɔnɔ

translation: I ⟨ye⟩ ne ka ɲagami-bagɛ ⟨ye⟩, sira-bagɛw: ani ne bɛna siyaw ɲagami ni i ye, ani ne bɛna masakɛyaw bɔn ni i ye.
